content.intro: In this lesson, you will study the character class with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you choose standard APIs that match the meaning and constraints of the data. In this lesson, focus on character classification and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.
